//: The domain half, compiled without the DOM.
D1 says src/core and src/firmware reach no browser API. This config is how
that is enforced rather than asked for: `lib` stops at ES2023, so `window`,
`document`, `fetch`, `Blob` and `File` are not in scope and naming one is a
compile error. Where the domain needs to read bytes out of a File, it takes
a structural interface the platform layer satisfies — see src/core/storage.
Run by `npm run typecheck` alongside tsconfig.json; both must pass.
